about: A web panel and API for managing PowerDNS name servers.

prs.title: Zone import understands @ in records
prs.broken: Importing a zone file stored @ literally in records, so www and mail pointed at a name like @.example.org that does not exist.
prs.changed: @ in record data now means the zone itself, as in any zone file.
prs.matters: Imported zones work right away, with no broken mail or web records.
